INSERT INTO flow_configuration_events (flow_type, scope_data, event_type, event_time, event_payload, prev_event_id)
            SELECT value ->> 'flow_type',
                   value ->> 'scope_data',
                   value ->> 'event_type',
                   value ->> 'event_time',
                   value ->> 'event_payload',
                   value ->> 'prev_event_id'
            FROM json_each($1)
            ORDER BY key
